description: Keyed. A business, a rail or an agent joins. A rail may attach a quote feed as an API key or an OAuth-style connection and one published rate. No placement is sold. SwapEazi does not hold or move money.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

contact.description: A work email address to reach the joining party.

from.description: Rails only, with rate: ISO 4217 source currency of the published rate, e.g. 'USD'.

name.description: The joining organisation's or agent's name.

party.description: Who is joining: business, rail or agent.

quote_feed.description: Rails only, optional: how the quote feed connects: api_key or oauth.

rail_kind.description: Rails only: bank, otc, ramp, psp or amm.

rate.description: Rails only: one published rate, destination units per source unit, e.g. 18.25.

to.description: Rails only, with rate: ISO 4217 destination currency, e.g. 'ZAR'.

name: join_network
title: Join the network
